attachment_paths.description: Readable workspace paths returned by chat attachment uploads.
attachment_paths.title: Attachment Paths

deep_work.description: Legacy per-message alias for thorough effort; never changes conversation kind.
deep_work.title: Deep Work

reading_context.description: The paper open in the reader; the server adds its title, folder and search order.

research_mode.description: research: follow the user's intent without automatic summaries or notes; learn: narrow sourced Q&A; understand: explain a paper and prerequisites; review: require cited summaries and durable paper notes. Omitted selects research, or learn for legacy Fast Answer. All modes are available per turn in Deep Work.
research_mode.title: Research Mode

response_effort.description: Per-message effort: auto follows intent; quick uses the smallest sufficient local or web evidence; thorough enables focused delegation. Does not imply saved artifacts. Overrides legacy deep_work and fast_answer selectors. Omitted defaults to auto on the chat endpoint.
response_effort.title: Response Effort

turn_intent.description: Explicit per-turn conceptual ideation; does not start a review or create artifacts.
turn_intent.title: Turn Intent

api_mode.description: Explicit generation protocol. Responses uses stateless local history and application function tools.
api_mode.title: Api Mode

default_reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort when a request has no explicit selection.
default_reasoning_effort.title: Default Reasoning Effort

serialize_model_switches.description: Prevent overlapping calls to different models on this provider. Defaults on for local providers.
serialize_model_switches.title: Serialize Model Switches

tool_reasoning_effort.description: Override reasoning effort on requests with function tools. Use none for models that reject reasoning with tools.
tool_reasoning_effort.title: Tool Reasoning Effort

serialize_model_switches.description: Allow same-model concurrency, but wait for active calls before switching models.
serialize_model_switches.title: Serialize Model Switches

context_window_tokens.description: Effective context size selected for this run, including compaction.
context_window_tokens.title: Context Window Tokens
